obligations.description: Asynchronous reset and first released edge
obligations.setup: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges.
obligations.stimulus: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges. Initialize writable scratch CSRs and dispatch/base fields, then reset at startup, while holding a stalled result, and with a short pulse entirely between rising edges. Read back previously nonzero scratch state after the short pulse. Issue a vector or mstatus/vtype read on the first released edge and repeat after it.
obligations.expected: All reset-cleared state and result payloads become zero asynchronously; no short pulse is missed. First-edge reads see zero MPP/vtype/capacity, and later reads see MPP0x1800, vtype0x10 and vector capacity4.
obligations.sampling: 1ns after rising clk, asynchronous reset assertion and settled query-selector changes; accepted values use pre-edge state.
obligations.checker: An independent self-contained native model predicts an abstract addressed bank map and retained result entry from input history only; no DUT output enters prediction. Separate actual and predicted wires feed four-state comparisons1ns after rising clk, asynchronous reset and any query-selector change after settling. Any difference emits UVM_ERROR; finite stimulus and mandatory sample/reset counts reject vacuity.

obligations.description: CSR address map and old-value read/modify/write
obligations.setup: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges.
obligations.stimulus: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges. For every bank and every mapped address, issue read, write, set and clear operations with disjoint and overlapping bit patterns, then read back. Include unmapped0x000,0x777,0xfff and unsupported vector addresses, repeated writes, and back-to-back writes/reads to different banks.

obligations.description: Captured metadata and ignored instruction bits
obligations.setup: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges.
obligations.stimulus: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges. Capture distinct result words with register/warp indices0 and maximum and both wxd values, then perturb every request and dispatch input during stalls. Local false expected claims constrain their actual windows and objects. Self-proof cannot establish an independent checker.
